title: World Cup 2026: The photographer following Tunisia in his father’s footsteps
summary: Tunisia are playing their last group stage match on Thursday. It will be a crucial match after two crushing defeats against Sweden and Japan and a change of coach after the first loss. They’ll be scrutinized by thousands of fans, but especially by photographer Hosni Manoubi, who has followed several World Cups, following in the footsteps of his father, who…
